checkpoint_finding.future_project_fit_rule: A transport map is outcome-exposed to every control and perturbed distribution used in its fit, and any autoencoder is encoder_seen for its training cells. A map fit to GSE281160 target cells cannot be evaluated as an unseen-target prediction for that target.

preprocessing_and_evaluation_incidents.finding: Default split utilities divide cells, not biological replicates or animals, and can place cells from one experimental unit across train and evaluation.
The trainer selects model.pt using MMD on loader.test. The benchmark outer test must never occupy this upstream test role.
PCA or autoencoder representations loaded before transport can expose evaluation expression unless fitted and frozen within outer training.
A perturbation's observed target distribution is required to learn the transport map; CellOT has no target identity input for a wholly unseen perturbation.
Optimal transport couples unpaired distributions; transported source rows are not biological pairs with target cells.

prediction_first_rule.gse313774: The 33 bulk RNA libraries cannot be treated as cells or distributions of cells. No direct CellOT stress prediction is valid on this source.

remaining_blockers: Keep CellOT unscheduled for the current held-target task; register a known-perturbation held-donor or held-context distributional task before fitting.
Resolve biological replicates and pairing, then assign grouped outer and inner roles before all preprocessing.
Fit PCA or autoencoder only on outer-training cells and export decoded absolute gene profiles.
Use inner validation rather than outer evaluation for the pinned trainer's MMD checkpoint selection.
Freeze each source-target perturbation map, context, normalization, genes, architecture, optimizer, seeds, and artifact hashes.
Pass isolated legacy runtime, safe state-dict resume, grouped split, and no-held-target-distribution fixtures.

systema_audit.rule: Decode transported cells to the frozen gene space, aggregate by biological replicate, and compute O_pert from training perturbation centroids only. OT sample couplings do not become replicates.
